label: Bible Study
prompt: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall _____, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verse: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
note: One of the clearest Old Testament glimpses of resurrection — sleepers in the dust waking up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Give _____ unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verse: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
note: The first words of the psalm David gave to Asaph the day the ark came home: give thanks.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two _____.
verse: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
note: Two mites made only a farthing (Mark 12:42), yet Jesus said this widow gave more than all the rich donors.

label: Deep Water
prompt: So they read in the book in the law of God _____, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
verse: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
note: Ezra's public reading came with explanation so the people understood — and they listened from morning until midday.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To speak evil of no man, to be no _____, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verse: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
note: Speak evil of no man, be no 'brawlers' — Paul's civility code for the believers on Crete.
